name: lvkit
description: View and diff VIs without LabVIEW.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In an untrusted workspace LVKit renders and diffs .vi files with its own bundled, self-contained runtime; the `lvkit.path` override (which would run an executable the workspace names) is ignored.

virtualWorkspaces.description: LVKit reads .vi files from disk and runs a local lvkit executable, neither of which is available in a virtual workspace.

lvkit.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `lvkit` executable. Use just `lvkit` if it is on your PATH, or an absolute path (e.g. a project venv's `.venv/bin/lvkit`). Overrides `#lvkit.importStrategy#`. Ignored in an untrusted workspace.

enumDescriptions: Use a `lvkit` found on your PATH if there is one; otherwise fall back to the bundled runtime.
Always use the runtime bundled with the extension (a self-contained Python with lvkit pre-installed).
lvkit.importStrategy.markdownDescription: Which lvkit to run. `useBundled` (default) uses the extension's own self-contained runtime — a bundled Python with lvkit pre-installed, so no Python or lvkit install is required, and it works under Windows Device Guard / Smart App Control. `fromEnvironment` prefers a `lvkit` on your PATH, falling back to the bundle. An explicit `#lvkit.path#` overrides this. Forced to `useBundled` in an untrusted workspace.

lvkit.searchPaths.markdownDescription: Extra directories to search for SubVIs, in addition to the auto-detected repository root.

enumDescriptions: Follow the editor theme — light diagram in a light theme, dark in a dark theme.
Always render the VI diagram with the light LabVIEW palette, regardless of editor theme.
Always render the VI diagram with the dark palette, regardless of editor theme.
lvkit.diagramTheme.markdownDescription: Color theme for the **VI diagram itself** (the rendered block diagram and diff SVGs). The surrounding viewer chrome always matches your VS Code theme; this setting controls only the diagram. `auto` (default) makes the diagram follow the editor theme; `light`/`dark` pin it regardless.
